metadata.title: That 2 kill moment where enemy forgot to play but I didn’t complain LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, were those kills really mine?
Enemy must’ve been on a snack break.
Click if your aim’s on holiday but kills still come home!
Valorant logic strikes again.

Tap if your kills are more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
